description: A channel dedicated to replaying a recorded capture, one file per bandwidth. passthrough:true bypasses the mixer (no float bus, noise floor, or other signals) and streams the capture matching the channel's current sample rate straight into VITA-49 packets. Retune the channel bandwidth and it selects the matching variant (1 MHz -> 1.536 MS/s file, 20 MHz -> 24.576 MS/s file); a bandwidth with no variant (e.g. 80 MHz) renders silence -- passthrough never resamples.
